Name: signed-axis-controls
Commands:
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro overrides to true
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro override to 0:0:0
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro up override to 10
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro right override to 20
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro clockwise override to 30
assign ecGyroBefore to "EC Test Gyro" gyro override
assign ecGyroBefore to round ecGyroBefore
increase "EC Test Gyro" gyro down override by 5
increase "EC Test Gyro" gyro left override by 5
set "EC Test Gyro" gyro counterclockwise override to 4
assign ecGyroAfter to "EC Test Gyro" gyro override
assign ecGyroAfter to round ecGyroAfter
set "EC Test Projector" projector offset to 1:2:3
set "EC Test Projector" projector up offset to 7
increase "EC Test Projector" projector down offset by 2
set "EC Test Projector" projector left offset to 4
increase "EC Test Projector" projector backward offset by 2
assign ecOffset to "EC Test Projector" projector offset
set "EC Test Projector" projector down rotation to 1
set "EC Test Projector" projector right rotation to 2
set "EC Test Projector" projector counterclockwise rotation to 2
assign ecRotationBefore to "EC Test Projector" projector rotation
increase "EC Test Projector" projector down rotation by 1
increase "EC Test Projector" projector left rotation by 1
set "EC Test Projector" projector clockwise rotation to -1
assign ecRotationAfter to "EC Test Projector" projector rotation
set "EC Test Projector" projector up rotation to 9
assign ecClamped to "EC Test Projector" projector rotation
print ecGyroBefore
print ecGyroAfter
print ecOffset
print ecRotationBefore
print ecRotationAfter
print ecClamped
if ecGyroBefore is 10:20:30 and ecGyroAfter is 5:15:-4 and ecOffset is -4:5:1 and ecRotationBefore is -1:2:-2 and ecRotationAfter is -2:1:-1 and ecClamped is 2:1:-1
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: signed axes or rotation clamp"

Name: lazy-expressions
Commands:
assign ecSource to 2
bind ecBound to ecSource * 3
assign ecSource to 5
assign ecFirst to ecBound
assign ecSource to 7
assign ecSecond to ecBound
assign ecValues to [1, 2, 3]
bind ecSum to sum of ecValues[]
assign ecValues[1] to 5
assign ecTotal to ecSum
assign ecIndex to 0
bind ecSelected to ecValues[ecIndex]
assign ecIndex to 2
assign ecChoice to ecSelected
bind ecAll to all of ecValues[] > 0
assign ecAllBefore to ecAll
assign ecValues[0] to -1
assign ecAllAfter to ecAll
if ecFirst is 15 and ecSecond is 21 and ecTotal is 9 and ecChoice is 3 and ecAllBefore and not ecAllAfter
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: lazy binding, aggregation or index"

Name: meal-blueprint
Commands:
tell "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor to create "kelp crisp"
assign ecRecipeQueued to "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor producing "kelp crisp"
if ecRecipeQueued
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: kelp crisp blueprint was not queued"

Name: meal-production
Commands:
tell "EC Test Kitchen" food processor to create 5 "kelp crisp"
turn on "EC Test Kitchen" food processor
wait 5
assign ecCooking to "EC Test Kitchen" food processor is running
assign ecProgress to "EC Test Kitchen" food processor progress
print ecCooking
print ecProgress
if ecCooking and ecProgress >= 0 and ecProgress <= 1
  turn off "EC Test Kitchen" food processor
  wait 5
  if "EC Test Kitchen" assembler is running
    print "EC_FAIL: disabled production"
  else
    assign ecMealsBefore to "EC Test Kitchen" inventories[1] amount "kelp crisp"
    turn on "EC Test Kitchen" assembler
    wait 12
    if "EC Test Kitchen" inventories[1] amount "kelp crisp" > ecMealsBefore
      print "EC_PASS"
    else
      print "EC_FAIL: no cooked item"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: production status or progress"
